system.description: When a hostile creature within 30 feet deals damage to you as a result of a Ninjutsu they cast, you can spend your reaction and multiples of 2 Star Chakra to reflect some if back. When their damage is rolled, select a number of damage die, starting from the highest die rolled for every 2 Star Chakra spent, removing it from their damage total, and adding it to the Reflection total. The triggering creature takes force damage equal to the removed damage die + 2d12.
